# tenancy.Project

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A project inside an organization; the parent of the optional unit tree.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `tenancy.Project` |
| Kind | `entity` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `project` |
| Permission | `core.project.read` |
